name: Ohio State University
character: The campus features a formal landscape with green quads, a lake, and mostly reddish-brown brick buildings.

landmarks.name: the Oval
landmarks.quote: The historical center of campus is the Oval, a quad of about 11 acres (4.5 ha).
landmarks.look: Large open green quad forming the central axis of campus.

landmarks.name: Ohio Stadium
landmarks.quote: at the corner of West Woodruff Avenue and Tuttle Park Place, next to Ohio Stadium.

landmarks.name: Mirror Lake
landmarks.quote: To the west are Hale Hall, the Kuhn Honors House, Browning Amphitheatre (a traditional stone Greek theatre) and Mirror Lake.

landmarks.name: University Hall
landmarks.quote: The original campus was laid out in the English country style with University Hall overlooking what would become the Oval.
landmarks.look: Campus hall overlooking the Oval, plain.

landmarks.name: Knowlton Hall
landmarks.quote: Knowlton Hall stands out from the general reddish-brown brick of Ohio State's campus with distinctive white marble tiles
landmarks.look: Building clad in white marble tiles with five white marble columns.

landmarks.name: South Oval
landmarks.quote: another, somewhat smaller expanse of green space commonly referred to as the South Oval.
landmarks.look: Smaller expanse of green space south of the Oval.

landmarks.name: Ohio State Cartoon Library & Museum
landmarks.quote: the Ohio State Cartoon Library & Museum, the world's largest repository of original cartoons;
landmarks.look: Campus library and museum building, plain.

landmarks.name: Hale Hall
landmarks.quote: To the west are Hale Hall, the Kuhn Honors House, Browning Amphitheatre (a traditional stone Greek theatre) and Mirror Lake.
